data.body:
Implemented and pushed as Gerrit change 2555 (https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/2555).

Written RED first: the census was committed before the documents were touched, and all five arms failed naming exactly the drift the plan claimed — verdict table missing key_not_valid_at_era; native-model types missing code_review/identity/session_log; native-model statuses missing idea; user-guide statuses missing archived/deleted; relation count saying 6 where Relation declares 7. Then the documents were corrected and all five went green.

AC4: six mutation checks, each RED with the document and direction named — drop a verdict row (missing [unavailable]), drop a type (missing [session_log]), add a bogus status (stale/extra [frozen]), drop a user-guide status (missing [archived]), change the count word seven->eight (says 8 ... declares 7), and reword the passage so the parser misses it (could not locate).

AC5: adding "frozen" to TicketStatus in the master fails the two DOC arms with missing [frozen], proving the expected values are read from the master at assert time and no copy lives in the test.

Two corrections to the plan worth recording.

First, the plan justified the missing verdict by citing docs/identity.md:138,147. That citation is misapplied: identity.md:147 says explicitly that it is describing the verify-authorship gate vocabulary and that it "is distinct from the separate verify-signature manifest-attestation verdict set". The drift is real regardless — verify_signature_result.schema.json does declare key_not_valid_at_era in its own enum — so I wrote the new row from the schema's own description rather than borrowing identity.md wording.

Second, the reuse-surface table opened with "Common verdicts include:", a hedge that made it non-exhaustive by construction. A completeness gate over prose that only claims to be partial asserts something the text never promised, so the prose now reads "The verdicts are exactly:" and the gate pins a promise the document actually makes. This was anticipated in the plan and is why the fix touches the wording and not only the list.

Gates: make lint and make typecheck clean; 425 passed in tests/interfaces/contracts.
